methods.name: Ion-pair with bromocresol purple (BCP) / methyl orange (MO), chloroform extraction (colorimetric, ICH-validated)
methods.solvent: chloroform extract of ion pair; aqueous phase potassium hydrogen phthalate-HCl buffer pH 3.0; stock in methanol/water
methods.equation: topilmadi in text (Table 1 is an image, not read)
methods.sample_prep: contents of 5 eye-drop containers pooled, diluted with water to ~100 ug/mL stock then working solution; 3 mL buffer, 2 mL dye (1e-3 M), extract 2x5 mL CHCl3 2 min, dry over Na2SO4, dilute to 10 mL; 10 mm cell; measured vs reagent blank
methods.validation: per ICH; r >= 0.9991 (n=6); intra/inter-day precision Table 2; standard addition Table 3; eye drops Table 4; t-test vs BP nonaqueous titration no significant difference; 1:1 ion pair (Job); colour stable 24 h
methods.interferences: lactose, dextrose, ethanol, starch, propylene glycol, HPMC, cellulose - no interference
